description: This file defines the DashletCacheBuilder class, responsible for building a cache of dashlets by scanning system directories for dashlet PHP files and associated metadata, and then storing this information in a cache file.

classes.name: DashletCacheBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for scanning module directories for dashlet PHP files and metadata, then caching this information for later use.

methods.description: Builds a cache of dashlets by scanning directories for dashlet PHP files and metadata, then writes the cache to a file.
